text:
2002 FIFA World Cup a wɔyɛe fi 31 May kɔsi 30 June no, na ɛyɛ adikan a wɔyɛe wɔ Asia na ɛyɛ adikan a ɔman mmienu, South Korea ne Japan, na wɔde dii mu. Akuo 32 na wɔde too akuo 8 mu, akuo biara mu nnipa 4, na akuo biara mu nnipa 2 a edi kan no kɔɔ single-elimination knockout stage a ɛkɔ round of 16, quarter-finals, semi-finals, third-place play-off ne final. Na ɛyɛ World Cup a etwa to a wɔde golden goal rule dii dwuma wɔ knockout rounds no mu. China, Ecuador, Senegal ne Slovenia nyinaa yɛɛ wɔn adikan wɔ tournament no mu.

Group stage no bɔɔ script no ntem ara: France a wɔyɛ defending champions no kɔɔ mu a wɔnnya goal biara, wɔtwaa Senegal a wɔrefi ase no 1–0, wɔne Uruguay dii draw na wɔtwaa Denmark. Nsɛm a ɛkɔɔ so no kɔɔ South Korea a wɔne Japan dii mu no nkyɛn, wɔ Guus Hiddink ase no wɔkɔɔ semi-finals—na ɛyɛ finish a ɛyɛ papa paa a Asian ɔman bi ayɛ na ɛyɛ adikan a kuw bi a ɛmfiri UEFA, CONMEBOL anaa CONCACAF mu kɔɔ hɔ. Wɔn anamɔn no wiee wɔ Germany nsa mu wɔ 1–0. Wɔ third-place play-off no mu no, Turkey dii South Korea 3–2, na Hakan Şükür buee match no wɔ sɛkɛnd 11 a etwa to akyi wɔ kick-off, na ɛyɛ goal a ɛyɛ ntɛm paa wɔ World Cup abakɔsɛm mu.

Final a wɔyɛe wɔ International Stadium Yokohama, wɔ nnipa 69,029 anim wɔ 30 June no, na Germany ne Brazil na wɔhyiaa. Wɔwiee no wɔ regulation mu, a enni extra time anaa penalties, na Brazil dii 2–0 wɔ Ronaldo goals mmienu (67', 79') mu. Opener no baeɛ ɛberɛ a Germany goalkeeper Oliver Kahn hwiee Rivaldo shot no guu na Ronaldo bɔɔ rebound no. Victory no maa Brazil title a ɛyɛ record 5; Germany wiee sɛ runners-up. Ronaldo brace no wiee ne personal redemption akyi ɛberɛ a Brazil twaa 1998 final no, na ne goals 8—the tournament’s most—no yɛ tally a ɛyɛ ɔsoro wɔ single-tournament mu firi Gerd Müller wɔ 1970. Ɛfata sɛ World Cup a wɔatutu no mu no, Golden Ball a ɛyɛ best player no kɔɔ Kahn nkyɛn, na ɛyɛ goalkeeper adikan na deɛ ɛwɔ hɔ nso a ɔno nko ara na wanya abaw no, ɛwɔ mu sɛ ɔyɛɛ mfomso wɔ final no mu.
